content.thinking: The verify script needs LD_LIBRARY_PATH (I forgot it on the last command). The main program itself ran fine (rc=0). Let me re-run the verification with the env var.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 -Bu -c "
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
import verify
req=json.load(open('/tmp/multi.json')); out=json.load(open('/tmp/multi_out.json'))
print('results', len(out['results']))
bad=0
for case,res in zip(req['cases'], out['results']):
    errs=verify.check(case,res); errs=verify.check_reports(case,res,errs)
    if errs: bad+=1; print('FAIL', errs[:4])
print('failures', bad)
"
